﻿# {{ site.first_name }} {{ site.last_name }} ({{ site.cn_name }})

> Personal academic website of {{ site.first_name }} "{{ site.nickname }}" {{ site.last_name }} ({{ site.cn_name }}), School of Mechanical, Medical and Process Engineering, Queensland University of Technology (QUT), Brisbane, Australia. {{ site.description }}

Zhipeng He completed his PhD at QUT in 2026 with the thesis "Building Adversarially Robust Predictive Systems for Tabular Data", supervised by Chun Ouyang, Alistair Barros and Catarina Moreira. He now works on AI-To-Data, a decentralised privacy-preserving AI framework for learning from multi-institute, multi-modality medical data, with Laith Alzubaidi. Alongside research he builds LLM-based agent systems as an independent full-stack AI engineer.

Research topics: {{ site.keywords }}.
